request.query: upper bound index multivariate integer polynomial at rational points with height and degree constraints

items.name: MvPolynomial.aeval_natDegree_le
items.type:
∀ {σ : Type v} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring R] {m n : ℕ} (F : MvPolynomial σ R),
  F.totalDegree ≤ m →
    ∀ (f : σ → Polynomial R), (∀ (i : σ), (f i).natDegree ≤ n) → ((MvPolynomial.aeval f) F).natDegree ≤ m * n

items.name: MvPolynomial.schwartz_zippel_sup_sum
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing R] [IsDomain R] [inst_2 : DecidableEq R] {n : ℕ} {p : MvPolynomial (Fin n) R},
  p ≠ 0 →
    ∀ (S : Fin n → Finset R),
      ↑{x ∈ Fintype.piFinset fun i => S i | (MvPolynomial.eval x) p = 0}.card / ∏ i, ↑(S i).card ≤
        p.support.sup fun s => ∑ i, ↑(s i) / ↑(S i).card

items.name: Polynomial.card_mahlerMeasure_le_prod
items.type:
∀ (n : ℕ) (B : NNReal),
  {p | p.natDegree ≤ n ∧ (Polynomial.map (Int.castRingHom ℂ) p).mahlerMeasure ≤ ↑B}.ncard ≤
    ∏ i, (2 * ⌊↑(n.choose ↑i) * B⌋₊ + 1)

items.name: ChevalleyThm.MvPolynomialC.degBound_le_degBound
items.type:
∀ {k₁ k₂ : ℕ} {D₁ D₂ : ℕ → ℕ},
  k₁ ≤ k₂ →
    ∀ (n : ℕ),
      (∀ i < n, D₁ i ≤ D₂ i) → ChevalleyThm.MvPolynomialC.degBound k₁ D₁ n ≤ ChevalleyThm.MvPolynomialC.degBound k₂ D₂ n

items.name: Polynomial.natDegree_sum_le_of_forall_le
items.type:
∀ {ι : Type w} (s : Finset ι) {S : Type u_1} [inst : Semiring S] {n : ℕ} (f : ι → Polynomial S),
  (∀ i ∈ s, (f i).natDegree ≤ n) → (∑ i ∈ s, f i).natDegree ≤ n

items.name: Polynomial.finite_mahlerMeasure_le
items.type: ∀ (n : ℕ) (B : NNReal), {p | p.natDegree ≤ n ∧ (Polynomial.map (Int.castRingHom ℂ) p).mahlerMeasure ≤ ↑B}.Finite

items.name: MvPolynomial.restrictDegree
items.type: (σ : Type u) → (R : Type v) → [inst : CommSemiring R] → ℕ → Submodule R (MvPolynomial σ R)
